synopsis: The Mining3 PDS toolkit is identified alongside ACARP C26028 as a January 2021 example of industry-shared test frameworks, benchmarking and independent review approaches [f445]. Chapter 1 groups it with ACARP C26028, NIOSH evaluations of commercial proximity systems and the MOSH verification regime as sources of comparability and credible independent evidence [f682]. The glossary restates that role and identifies MOSH as the South African regime; the supplied facts do not describe the toolkit’s procedures or report specific validation results [f15630, f682, f445].

relations.note: The glossary restates the frameworks’ shared role in comparability and credible independent evidence.
Dates Mining3 and ACARP examples to January 2021 and specifies benchmarking and independent review.
Industry-shared testing, benchmarking and independent review underpin comparability and credible evidence.
